purpose: Controlled session-loss investigation; separate from the 432 original case executions.
transport: Streamable HTTP via local forwarding proxy

clients.python: mcp 2.2.0, same Python environment for both server versions
clients.rust: rmcp 3.4.0, same Cargo.lock and dependency cache for both server versions

wire.body:
event: message
data: {"result":{"tools":[{"name":"ping","description":"Check whether the MCP server is responsive.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{}}},{"name":"delay","description":"Delay a successful MCP response to test client timeout behavior.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"delayMs":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":30000,"description":"Response delay in milliseconds."}},"required":["delayMs"]}},{"name":"hang","description":"Never respond unless the MCP request is cancelled.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{}}},{"name":"disconnect","description":"Close the MCP transport before this request can receive a response.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{}}},{"name":"malformed_message","description":"Return one deterministic response that violates a selected JSON-RPC rule.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"variant":{"type":"string","enum":["missing-jsonrpc","invalid-jsonrpc-version","result-with-error"]}},"required":["variant"]}},{"name":"duplicate_response","description":"Return the same JSON-RPC response twice for this request.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{}}},{"name":"session_loss","description":"Invalidate this HTTP session during or after the current request.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"activation":{"type":"string","enum":["during_request","after_response"]}},"required":["activation"]}}]},"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2}
